description: This Java class `IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader` implements a precondition header used in HTTP requests for conditional requests, specifically handling the 'If-None-Match' header with entity tags (ETags). It provides methods to check if a given entity tag meets the condition and to extract instances from header collections.

classes.name: IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader
classes.description: Immutable class representing the 'If-None-Match' HTTP precondition header, used for conditional requests based on entity tags.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key associated with 'If-None-Match'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity tags to match.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Determines if the header's condition is met for a given entity tag based on RFC 7232.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Extracts an `IfNoneMatchPreconditionHeader` instance from a collection of headers if present.
